serverInfo.name: white-label-loyalty-mcp
serverInfo.title: White Label Loyalty MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for White Label Loyalty, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rewards can my customers buy right now, and what do they cost in points?"; "Show the wallet and tier progress of the customer whose token I have."; "How close is this customer to the next tier?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes White Label Loyalty data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run whitelabelloyalty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run whitelabelloyalty_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run whitelabelloyalty_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. whitelabelloyalty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_list_rewards
tools.title: List rewards
tools.description: List the rewards in the loyalty programme: name, price in points, tier, availability and whether each can be purchased. Pass userToken to see the rewards that customer may view. Use the filter purchasable:(eq:!t) to hide rewards that cannot be bought. White Label Loyalty API: GET /rewards.

limit.description: Maximum number of rewards to return.

sort.description: Field to sort by, for example name or price.

filter.description: O-Rison encoded filter, for example price:(gt:10) or purchasable:(eq:!t) for purchasable rewards only.

userToken.description: Optional end-user JWT. With it, the reply shows what this customer may view, which can differ from the anonymous view.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_get_reward
tools.title: Get reward
tools.description: Get one reward by id: description, points cost, stock, availability window, tier and discounts. White Label Loyalty API: GET /rewards/{id}.

userToken.description: Optional end-user JWT. With it, the reply shows what this customer may view, which can differ from the anonymous view.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_get_my_wallet
tools.title: Get customer wallet
tools.description: Get the loyalty wallet of the customer behind userToken: points balance, tier and progress to the next tier, and vouchers. White Label Loyalty API: GET /users/me/wallet.

userToken.description: The end-user JWT your app issued to this customer (RS256 or HS256). Not the API key.

includeAllUnvalidatedVouchers.description: Also return vouchers that are not validated yet, not only the unredeemed ones.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_get_my_wallet_predictions
tools.title: Get customer wallet predictions
tools.description: Get points liability predictions for the customer behind userToken: spend and earn caps and points expiry. White Label Loyalty API: GET /users/me/wallet/predictions.

userToken.description: The end-user JWT your app issued to this customer (RS256 or HS256). Not the API key.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_purchase_reward
tools.title: Purchase reward
tools.description: Purchase a reward for the customer behind userToken. If the reward has a points cost, that many points are deducted from the wallet. Not idempotent: a repeat call buys again. Only call it when the customer asked for this reward. White Label Loyalty API: POST /commands/purchase_reward.

userToken.description: The end-user JWT your app issued to this customer (RS256 or HS256). Not the API key.
